title: Chapter 725
paragraphs: Chapter 725
Episode 182. The blind spot of the temporary alliance (2)
Jin headed to the underground prison of the Tikan palace with Kasimir.
A few comrades, including the siblings Meri and Tona, were watching Rin in the underground prison.
Although she was in prison, Rin was sitting at a desk drinking tea, instead of being tied up.
[You're here, 12th Generation.]
Rin stood up from her seat to greet Jin.
"Chairman of the Law Society. No, I should call you the Black Sword Chairman. I heard Rosa appointed you as the chairman of the Black Sword."
[I failed to uphold the law as a member of the Law Society, and as a Black Sword member, I couldn't execute the rebels, so I'm not qualified to hold any position. Just call me by my name.]
Jin didn't answer and sat down in front of Rin, staring at her eyes, dyed black in chaos.
Rin was clearly completely consumed by chaos, but she hadn't lost her reason at all.
A certain determined will was felt.
Jin read from Rin an atmosphere that only those who are prepared to endure pain and sacrifice could have.
"The verification of the information you informed us of yesterday has been completed."
The information Rin had given to Tikan was about Rosa and the spaceship Ram.
According to her, Rosa is currently losing some control over Hufester, and there was a secret about the spaceship Ram that Rosa didn't know.
[That's fortunate.]

"Until Yuria's judgement came out, to be honest, it was hard to believe. Wasn't the fact that you came itself a scheme of Rosa, or as the situation doesn't seem good for the monster now, are you trying to side with us again? That's what I doubted."
[I understand. It couldn't be helped.]
"Why didn't you join the rebels from the start, but instead made a pact with the Prophet?"

[If I had chosen the rebels from the beginning, you wouldn't have been able to hear any information about the monster's weaknesses. I wanted to fight together more than anything, but... I thought there was no hope in that.]
"So you decided to become an insider in the Corrupted Sword Garden?"
When Meri asked, Rin nodded.
[I thought that by becoming an insider, there might be some kind of opportunity...]
"I clearly remember the day Diffus Oraboni was captured, you saved me."
[However, there would be countless knights of the family that I killed with my own hands.]
Rin said, putting down her teacup.
Jin realized that she was feeling guilty.
As an 'individual' named Rin, it certainly would have been a better choice to fight with the rebels and die honorably.
However, Rin had been obeying Rosa's orders for just such a moment.
If it's for the family, she could endure any personal suffering and guilt.
Even if she ended up recorded in history as a terrible traitor, it would be the same.

[In addition, just like the deceased 4th generation... I was slowly forgetting my original will, succumbing to the chaos of the prophet. If you hadn't managed to kill the prophet this time, I would have truly become a traitor.]
A moment of silence passed.
[Has the day of the final battle been decided?]
"Not yet. It will likely be decided in tomorrow's meeting."

[Although it's something we discussed last night, it would be good to act within a month at least. There isn't much time left for me and the remaining knights. Our lives are fading due to the death of the prophet.]
"Because of the contract with the prophet?"
[Yes. Regardless, if we die before attacking Hufester, we won't be of any help.]
Jin nodded.
[Then, I should return now. If I leave my position unattended any longer, it might arouse suspicion from the monster.]
Rin stood up.
[This might be our last meeting, 12th generation. When you and the temporary alliance start attacking Hufester, from then on we will focus on stopping the spaceship Ram.]
The method to temporarily halt the operation of the spaceship 'Ram'.
That was the information Rin had obtained as an insider.
[Moreover, even before Ram comes to a complete halt, the dreadful ship won't be attacking the Barmel Union.]
Rosa thought that she alone had control over the spaceship Ram.
However, the dead prophet had prepared to seize control of Ram, anticipating the day when Rosa had to be dealt with.
He had informed Rin of this fact once her 'brainwashing' was deemed complete.
Rin extended her hand to Jin, asking for a handshake.
Jin looked alternately at her hand and eyes for a few seconds.
[Please, defeat Rosa... the monster, 12th generation. Stop our Runecandel from perishing so horribly.]
Jin grasped Rin's hand.
He felt the rough, sturdy palm of an elder who had devoted decades solely to the family of Runecandel.
"I will definitely do it."
Jin personally saw off Rin. As they exited through a secret passage leading from the underground prison to the sea, the youngest division was waiting for them.
Among them, Mesa bowed his head in front of Rin.
"Great aunt."
[Mesa.]
Rin met Mesa's eyes and smiled.

[The head of the family, Sir Siron, was once the ruler of this world, but he is still wandering the Black Sea, and Rosa is pushing the family and the world towards ruin as a monster. Thus, you are serving a more competent ruler than my generation.]
"I will become a knight, without any deficiency, for my lord and my family."
[Good… When the 12th generation recovers the family, there will be a lot to do. Can I rest in peace, leaving the remaining tasks to you?]
"…Yes, Great Aunt."
[Excellent.]
The remaining Runecandels did not leave their place until Rin disappeared over the sea.
Hufester.
The army of chaos was gathering in the Sword Garden. Eyes, stained in chaos, looked up at Rosa, who was seated on the throne.
For the first time since becoming a monster, she showed signs of fatigue. Her eyes were dark, her lips were dry, and her hair was lifelessly drooping.
The chaos she should have gained in the Recalton battle was not properly absorbed, and a piece of the power she shared with Diphus had been completely destroyed.
Rosa stroked the beloved sword she had been using since her human days, indifferent to the fact that her fingers sometimes cut on the blade, causing black blood to drip.
She didn't care. She just mindlessly caressed the blade, seemingly oblivious to the pain.
The commanding knights watching Rosa felt a certain unease. Unlike the lower-ranking knights, completely submerged in madness, they still retained some will and reason as humans.
They hadn't considered losing at Recalton.
They had been planning to start a new invasion before the temporary alliance finished their repairs, expecting a great victory.
But Diphus and the prophet were dead, and Rosa, despite her army in front of her, was not hiding her fatigue.
[...The army has gathered, Head of the Family.]
Eventually, Lionel stepped forward and spoke to Rosa.
Rosa didn't reply, just kept stroking the sword.
A chilly wind occasionally messed up her hair.
[Head of the Family.]
Lionel called Rosa once more. He seemed to feel the anxiety of the high-ranking knights, who still retained their rationality, on his back.
Only Pardler seemed indifferent, smirking regardless of the situation.
Rosa only opened her mouth after about thirty minutes had passed.
[Former Head of the Family, Sir Lionel.]
[Your command?]
[Have you ever loved a child?]
Caught off guard by the unexpected question, Lionel could not comprehend Rosa's intentions.
[Why do you ask that suddenly…? Is it because of the 4th generation’s death?]
[That child was far superior to the bug over there, but not enough to have any special affection.]

At those words, Joshua, who had been standing below the throne, flinched slightly. Since the Prophet's death, Joshua could no longer create any special despair. It was because the hope called prophecy had disappeared.
[Answer my question.]
[I have.]
[Then, what did you do for such a child?]
[You keep asking hard questions... In my case, I passed on the family. This very place, the Sword Garden.]
Then Rosa seemed satisfied and nodded. There was a glimmer of life in her previously dark eyes.
[I wanted to pass this place onto that child as well. But since I can't do that... before I confront the youngest. As a mother, I feel the need to give a proper gift. Something like a playground.]
[A playground, you said?]
Rosa stood up.
[I will start building a castle now.]
[Head of the family, what do you mean?]
[A final stage for the youngest. It needs to be intricate and beautiful, with characters fitting for the child's death that will certainly become a legend.]
Lionel was wondering how to express his worries, and there was a stir in the army.
However, the next moment, they could only gasp when they saw Rosa lifting her hand stretched into the void.
Whoosh…!
Black pillars suddenly sprouted to the left and right of the castellan at Rosa's touch.
Like a painting on canvas, every time she gestured, the frame of the 'castle' was being created.
It was a creation, impossible without being a god.
At the same time, from behind the throne, a pale aura began to rise massively like a tidal wave.
It was the sight of new souls emerging from the underworld.
Lionel could only shudder, feeling the power emanating from them.
[While I'm building the castle, all you need to do... is fill up this place so it doesn't look empty. Prepare for the final battle in your respective places. Prepare to welcome my son.]
When Rosa commanded, Lionel and the army knelt down at once.
The ancient heroes of Runecandel, whose bodies began to form as they escaped the underworld, also paid homage to Rosa and raised their swords in salute.
And Rosa momentarily fixed her gaze on Lin, standing in the middle of the Black Sword Society.
She smiled as if she knew exactly what he was thinking.
Lin bowed his head, unable to feel Rosa's gaze.
